nom: Exuviance Anti-Aging Radiance Face Serum with PHAs

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are mixed: some say it works very well for them, including one who no longer needs a separate moisturizer, while another reports it makes her oilier during the day and now only uses it at night.
segments.dry: Several reviewers with dry skin, including some in harsh winter or high-desert climates, report it revives dull, brittle skin and restores softness and hydration.
segments.sensitive: Several sensitive-skin reviewers, including one who says she is allergic to almost everything, report no issues and call it a holy grail; two others instead report burning, stinging, or peeling, with one who has rosacea recommending it only for those without sensitive skin.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal and even-keeled, without particular dryness, oiliness, or acne, says the serum feels elegant, though she cannot personally judge whether it changed her skin since it was already in good shape.
segments.combination: The two reviewers with combination skin, one of whom also describes herself as very allergic to everything, report no breakouts or clogged pores and call it a holy grail for radiance.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature, including several in their 40s to 60s, report renewed glow and elasticity, visibly softer fine lines, and relief from age-related dullness and dryness.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers, including many describing mature or aging skin, report visibly softer fine lines, firmer texture, smaller pores, and renewed glow, often within days to a few weeks; a few reviewers, mostly longtime users, report the reformulated version no longer has any noticeable effect.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers say the serum leaves skin visibly more hydrated, dewy, and plumper, including several with dry winter or desert-climate skin; two longtime users of an earlier formula say the current version instead leaves their skin dry with no hydrating effect.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers, including one improving her general redness, report the serum calmed redness with use; one reviewer with rosacea says it instead made her skin peel and look shiny, and another new user experienced burning sensitivity in her first days of use.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visibly faded dark spots, sun spots, or acne scars with regular use over several weeks; no reviewer in this set reports spots worsening or staying the same.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some say it even reduced existing acne or clogged pores; one reviewer suspects it may have contributed to a mild breakout, though she was using it alongside other new products at the same time.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily skin say it works well without over-hydrating or feeling heavy, and one no longer needs a separate moisturizer; one reviewer instead finds it makes her skin noticeably oilier during the day and now uses it only at night.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky residue after applying
Doubles well as a makeup primer
Scent divides opinion, some dislike it
Absorbs quickly once it sets in
Expensive, though it lasts a long time
Thick, rich texture works best layered

extraits.texte: Hi, I have used this product for years and loved it before. It used to give me clear, bouncy, hydrated skin. The recent last two bottles I bought do not do this. It is drying and it has no effect on my skin whatsoever. This is extremely disappointing. Why do companies change what works? This has been noticeable. I am not purchasing anymore. Thank you

I have rosacea and used this it was working at first but the I noticed it made me skins peel like dead skin any time I put moisturizer on top and made me look very shiny. I think it's great if you don't have sensitive skin! It also has a fragrance so heads up

This serum has been very effective for me, however I have oily skin and it does make me a bit oilier. To avoid the oil during the day, it has been working well at night, and I just use the serum, no moisturizer on top.

I received this as a sample, thinking okay.. yeah, another serum that probably won't work... I've used it 4 times which was about the entire amount in the small packet, but my face looks absolutely amazing. I am so glad I found this product!! I was kinda shocked by the price tag but the amount you use to how much you get is fine. It literally works so well, I cannot complain. I have Mature skin and lately my regular products haven't been giving me that glow, This serum gave me everything back! I pair it with bronzing drops and my skin has never looked better. Fine smile lines was depressing me, nothing I was using was working, I am already seeing them vanish.. Its literally a miracle ♡ I hope this review helps you. It's also helped with the dryness. This past winter has really dried my skin out, horribly. This serum is helping with that also!

I found this extremely sticky which I love for under makeup. I didn't think it would be much different from other HA serums but this packs a punch and a little goes a long way. I have quite sensitive and oily skin and this works very well for me.

extraits.titre: I can't even believe how amazing ￼
extraits.texte: I have mild rosacea, and this stuff has been a godsend. I've tried everything out there, and nothing actually healed. This stuff has healed my skin, gotten rid of fine lines, probably taken off at least 10 years, and makes my make up glow!!! I am 48 years old and this stuff provides a barrier so that my make up does not settle on to my face and stays looking perfectly satin all day. It acts as a primer under makeup and provides a totally flawless finish that stays put all day.

This amazing antiaging serum energize dull, stressed skin, boosting youthful radiance right on first use and it get more and more visible results each time, applying on the morning and before sleep. The serum is easy spreading and quickly absorbed by the skin: great hydration for all skin types and non comedogenic for oily or combined skin like mine. I didn't feel any need to apply another hydrating cream after it (oily skin). The serum improve 7 signs of photoaging including loss of firmness, dullness, rough texture, lines and wrinkles, enlarged pores and uneven skin tone. Radiance Duo from Exuviance - Pure Retinol Correcting Peel & Radiance Serum Yes, I'm in love for this duo: my skin is rejuvenating a lot! The peeling and the multi task serum together made my pores shrink and clean without break outs and diminished the acne and other marks as well. Bonus: they're perfect for neck area too and the serum is perfect as a primer for makeup.
